description: Explain which Schedulala plan the connection is on and where plans are described. Use this when a call fails because an active Schedulala plan is required (quota_exceeded, or the sandbox plan), or when the user asks about their plan. This tool never sells anything: it only points to the informational plans page on schedulala.com; any plan change happens there in the browser, never in this chat.
name: get_upgrade_link
title: Get Plan Info
